rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. Test 1 (i1040gi p. 14) covers a parent whose main home you kept up for all of 2025, with or without the parent living with you; the project's hoh_test1 encodes only the parent who does not live with you (the question asks "For a parent not living with you"), and a dependent parent who lived with you all year in the home you kept up qualifies you through Test 2, item 1 (hoh_test2 admits a claimed parent who lived with you more than half the year; household.test2_met needs household.home_cost, answered yes here). Head of household eligibility is the same either way. The helper label is narrowed to say so (T-018 commit).
